newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS BOURSE CLEARS TRIA ALFA RIGHTS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS BOURSE CLEARS TRIA ALFA RIGHTS ISSUE.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange gave its green light to Tria Alfa's 126 million drachma rights issue, it said in a statement.
Textiles firm Tria Alfa will issue 105,000 new registered ordinary shares at 1,200 drachmas. The shares will have a par palue of 860 drachmas.
The terms of the rights issue will be one new registered ordinary share for every five ordinary or preferred shares outstanding.
Proceeds will finance the company's investment plan and reduce debt, the bourse said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
